# Procedure log types
{: .no_toc}

Entry schemas for procedure logs: measurements followed over time for one procedure.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

{::options toc_levels="2..2" /}
1. TOC
{:toc}

## Impedances log

Logs electrode impedance measurements per channel, with impedance and phase values, unit and measurement frequency, for example to track an implant over days.

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `Impedances` | **Required.** Multi-select. Impedance values ordered to correspond to the listed channels. |
| `Impedance unit` | Choice. The unit shared by all impedance values in this log entry. Options: Ω, kΩ, MΩ. |
| `Measurement frequency` | Quantity with unit. The stimulus frequency used for the impedance measurement. Units: Hz, kHz. |
| `Phases (°)` | Multi-select. Phase angles ordered to correspond to the listed channels. |
| `List of channels` | List of integers. Channel numbers corresponding by position to the impedance and phase arrays. |

## Linear displacement log

Logs the displacement of a movable implant at each log time, for example a probe advanced on a microdrive.

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `Displacement` | **Required.** Quantity with unit. The signed or absolute displacement recorded at this log time. Units: nm, µm, mm, cm, m. |

## Tetrode adjustment log

Logs adjustments of individual tetrodes on a drive, with one row per tetrode moved at each log time.

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `Tetrode adjustments` | **Required.** Table of rows. One row per tetrode adjusted at this log time; tetrodes left untouched are omitted. |
| `Tetrode adjustments › Tetrode` | **Required.** Integer. Position of the tetrode on the drive, numbered from 1 as the lab labels it. Range: ≥ 1. |
| `Tetrode adjustments › Advance` | **Required.** Quantity with unit. How far the tetrode was moved in this adjustment, as a distance or as screw rotation; negative values retract. Units: µm, mm, turn, °. |

## API access

The same types are documented for API users, with property codes, versions and payload examples, on the [ProcedureLog schemas API page](/api/schemas/procedurelog/).
